{{Quote|You were supposed to be escorting me to the ''Rebels''{{'}} Trade Conference on Daalang. That's important, Solo... That's people's ''lives''!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
The '''Rebels' Trade Conference''' was a meeting of Rebel officials and companies or organizations that were dealing with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They would negotiate prices, quantities, and rendezvous points to stay out of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] clutches.<ref name="TPE" />
